scope: fresh-seed CPU feasibility pilot; not paper formal evidence

L1_validity_and_accounting.rule: 48 finite rows; exact 61,200 charged/completed actor transitions per row; zero self-fresh error

L2_positive_learning.rule: strategic mean return change is strictly positive in both service profiles

L3_heterogeneous_lower_tail.rule: strategic lower-quartile mean return exceeds raw-full-data by at least 2% of the absolute raw lower-quartile return

L4_heterogeneous_mean_safety.rule: strategic mean return is no more than 1% below raw-full-data

L5_heterogeneous_directionality.rule: strategic final return strictly exceeds paired raw-full-data in at least 5/8 seeds

L6_nontrivial_debt_control.rule: mean fraction of strategic packet scales strictly between zero and one lies in [0.1, 0.8] in both profiles

L7_balanced_mean_safety.rule: strategic mean return is no more than 1% below raw-full-data under balanced service

L8_split_cost_value.rule: strategic exceeds raw-half-data in mean and lower-quartile return in both profiles

L9_reproducibility.rule: primary and isolated-reproduction summary files are byte-identical

decision_rule: all mandatory gates must pass before any GPU pilot is preregistered; no gate, seed, threshold, mode, profile, or budget may be changed after outcome access
